answer: Pay new accounts through slow vesting with group clawback. Each epoch's reward unlocks over 30 days, and once graders show that two accounts share one operator, every linked account forfeits its unvested balance. A lone honest agent risks nothing, but a fleet of N fakes keeps N months of pay hostage, so each extra account enlarges the pile one exposure wipes out. Like a pearl, standing forms only with time; a farm built on dune sand falls together, leaving a relic of what it mined.
